recipes.name: high-temp-alert
recipes.description: Alert when any sensor reports temperature above threshold

steps.query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.temp > 10 RETURN n.name, n.temp, n.zone
steps.description: Find sensors with temperature above 10 degrees

recipes.name: door-open-warning
recipes.description: Alert when a cold storage door is left open

steps.query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.door = 'open' AND n.zone <> 'dock' RETURN n.name, n.zone
steps.description: Find non-dock doors that are open

recipes.name: team-collaboration
recipes.description: Find engineers in the same team and city for collaboration opportunities

steps.query: MATCH (a), (b) WHERE a.team = b.team AND a.city = b.city AND a.id <> b.id RETURN a.name, b.name, a.team, a.city

recipes.name: critical-status-watch
recipes.description: Monitor all nodes with critical status

steps.query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.status = 'critical' RETURN n.name, n.zone, n.temp
